# PhysicsConstraintBreakForce 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsConstraintBreakForce:Void constraint:Int32, force:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `constraint` | In | Int32 | required | The constraint. |
| `force` | In | Float32 | required | The force in newtons, 0 for a constraint that does not break. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Makes a constraint break when it carries more than this force in a step. A broken constraint stops working for good (the bodies move freely), `GetPhysicsConstraintBroken` says so. The force is an estimate from the solver and is only good for breaking when the load is clearly larger or smaller than the value. 0 turns breaking off.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
